answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, released only after three unrelated confirmations, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The echo holds work receipts rather than names, so the pearl of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The sonnet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
